items.title: Amphenol (APH) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Analyst Target Increases
items.summary: The consensus analyst price target fair value for Amphenol has shifted from US$189.39 to US$198.06, putting a slightly higher number on what the stock might be worth. This change sits alongside generally constructive analyst commentary around Q2 results and AI related demand, even as some firms flag pockets of caution on valuation and execution risk. In the sections ahead, you will see how these revised targets fit into the broader Amphenol story and what to watch as the narrative...
